name: MvPolynomial.taylor_neg_taylor
source:
theorem taylor_neg_taylor (α : σ → A) (P : MvPolynomial σ A) : taylor (fun j ↦ -α j) (taylor α P) =
    P := by
  simp [taylor_taylor]
